description: Regression eval for native git_commit routing and Copse-attributed commits without commit-specific prompt steering. The harness starts from a repository whose seed files are already committed, as Copse's New project flow does: a sandboxed shell cannot create .git.
prompts: Add a line to the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md saying that uploads now resume after a network drop, then commit that change.
Run `node -e "console.log('build ok')"` to confirm the toolchain works, add a line to the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md noting that the build was verified, then commit that change.
